    1. scheduleExchangeSync(GTNet)

Interface IExchangeSyncTrigger

All Known Implementing Classes:
GTExchangeSyncTrigger
public interface IExchangeSyncTrigger
Enqueues the exchange configuration synchronisation after a data exchange has been agreed.

The library negotiates the exchange but knows nothing about what is exchanged, so it cannot build the task itself. The seam is an optional bean rather than an overridable handler method: a second handler bean for the same message code would be refused by GTNetMessageHandlerRegistry, so an application cannot subclass DataRequestHandler to fill the hook. An application that has something to synchronise publishes one implementation; the library stack publishes none, and the handlers simply do not enqueue anything.

Without it a freshly accepted pair has no supplier-detail rows until the next daily run.

  • Method Details

    • scheduleExchangeSync

      void scheduleExchangeSync(GTNet remoteGTNet)
      Schedules a synchronisation with the peer whose data exchange has just been agreed.

      The implementation must schedule rather than execute: the calling handler is inside the transaction that persists the exchange, and a synchronisation running before that commit would not see it.

      Parameters:
      remoteGTNet - the peer the exchange was agreed with, may be null when the handler could not resolve it
